subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result outputs may OpenClaw hide from model-visible provider messages to preserve prefix-cache stability?
rationale: The bug is real, but deciding that normal command, file, web, memory, or plugin tool outputs can be hidden is a product/runtime semantics decision, not just a provider formatting fix.

options.title: Narrow to lifecycle-only results
options.body: Keep any mitigation limited to low-information heartbeat/session lifecycle outputs and require normal tool outputs to remain visible to the model.

options.title: Add an explicit visibility signal
options.body: Require tool owners or runtime code to mark cache-only results explicitly instead of using a global tool-name list.

options.title: Defer to isolation/pruning work
options.body: Reject prompt-time suppression for now and keep solving the issue through heartbeat isolation, pruning, or the related provider-cache policy PRs.

recommendation.title: Narrow to lifecycle-only results
recommendation.body: Keep any mitigation limited to low-information heartbeat/session lifecycle outputs and require normal tool outputs to remain visible to the model.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current-main history for provider conversion and prompt-cache boundary behavior.
